Dana L: Kickoff: CloudPartnerX wants an "ops-focused" lab to go along with the ref-arch + terraform kit. Target audience: their infra + SI ops folks. 45m session next Tue. Need agenda + owners.
Marta V: I can own the ops lab content. Thinking: 1) high-level topology (5m) 2) hands-on deploy (20m) 3) runbook & rollback (10m) 4) packaging + next steps (10m).
Kyle H: I'll do the hands-on deploy demo. Plan: use the minimal terraform module that provisions network, an instance pool, and configures the runtime with KMS. Demo flow: git -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke test.
Dana L: Partner specifically asked for an ops runbook and a short checklist for marketplace maintainers. Add that to packaging section. Also they want notes on autoscaling and how dedicated vs hosted changes ops.
Marta V: Good point. I'll add a short table slide: "operational differences" (hosted, dedicated, private) and a 1-page runbook snippet for on-call.
Kyle H: Terraform snippet I'll demo (minimal):
```hcl
module "cp_x_ops_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnerx/terraform/ops-lab"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  min_nodes = 1
  max_nodes = 3
  enable_kms = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Partner-eng: Quick FYI  they want the runbook to include: how to evacuate workloads if a GPU node becomes degraded, how to roll back to a smaller model, and how to switch routing to fallback region.
Dana L: We'll include an "evacuation" checklist and a scripted failover example. Add a short snippet for cordoning nodes and draining workloads.
Kyle H: I'll add smoke tests under tests/ops/smoke_deploy.sh and an example alerting rule for token latency > 200ms.
Marta V: Can infra create a short-lived project for the demo? Request: cp-x-ops-lab-2025-08-12 with creds 48h TTL. Who files infra request?
Dana L: I'll file it. Tagging infra: @ops-bot please create sandbox project cp-x-ops-lab-2025-08-12 with 48h creds and add Marta + Kyle as viewers.
ops-bot: Sandbox project created: cp-x-ops-lab-2025-08-12. Creds expiry set to 48h. Rehearsal scheduled: 2025-08-11 16:00 UTC. Repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerx/ops-lab/enablement-checklist.md
Kyle H: I'll push the ops-lab module and a README with troubleshooting steps (firewall, SGs, model pull auth) by EOD tomorrow. Also will include a short sample PromQL alert:
```promql
avg_over_time(request_latency_ms[5m]) > 200
```
Marta V: I'll draft the packaging checklist (manifest fields, icons, support contact, semver for modules) and the runbook snippets. Will open PR to repos/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerx/docs/ops-runbook.md.
Dana L: Owners: Marta (ops runbook + packaging), Kyle (terraform + tests + smoke alerts), Dana (coord + rehearsal). Rehearse 24h before.
partner-eng: We'll circulate the partner invite after rehearsal; partner asks if we can include a short maintenance window playbook for their SI teams.
Marta V: I'll add a maintenance window section (draining, model swap, rolling upgrade plan) to the runbook.
Dana L: Thanks team 680 post PR links here when ready and I'll update the calendar invite.
